message: fix(merchant): preserve pending quantity edits across snapshot refresh
purpose: The new native test found that assigning SpinBox.MaxValue during every snapshot reformatted its pending text. Update bounds only when changed and preserve pending text and caret across that necessary update. Keep all original quantity, signed-comparison, sale and layout assertions. Free the manually constructed tooltip fixture as a node tree rather than disposing only its managed wrapper. This fixes the concrete failure and test-owned orphan controls without suppressing leak diagnostics.

replacements.new: selected = ids[(int)index]; cardStamp = ""; amount.Value = 1; amount.GetLineEdit().Text = "1"; RefreshSnapshot();

replacements.old:
using(var tip=slot._MakeCustomTooltip(slot.TooltipText))
                    check(tip is Control c&&c.CustomMinimumSize.X==CompactItemCard.Width,"Equipment slots use the compact comparison tooltip");
panel.RefreshSnapshot();check(quantity.GetLineEdit().Text=="7","Snapshot refresh preserves an unsubmitted typed quantity");
